title.narrative: Innovative Policy and Financing for Development

description.narrative: The purpose of the Initiation Plan is to develop a Project Document and to undertake early-stage activities necessary to ensure continuity of previous programme activities which were critical to implement Government’s development programme articulated in the IDPFI project. The early-stage activities will contribute to and be organized around the new NST 2, UNSDCF/CPD 2025-2029 . Some activities which were implemented under the Innovative Development Policy and Finance for Impact (IDPFI) would serve as the bridging initiatives towards the operationalization of the intended ProDoc. With a focus on supporting innovative policy design and formulation, as well as continuing support to innovative financing solutions, all the activities outlined in this PIP are meant to facilitate the transition into the new CPD with ease. These will be driven by the need to drive inclusive growth; strengthening institutional capacities; resource mobilisation strategies; climate resilience and an enhanced regional and global engagement.
